scope: All 56 lot-labelled result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 451 grid for the 12 July 2006 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the date, states a total of 56 lots across 3 catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 rows reconcile to the secondary grid. The secondary grid exposes 56 distinct lot labels exactly once and reports Offered: 56. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all 56 lot labels appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 56 and the secondary Offered: 56 denominator
